custom_logic_notes: Duplex mode allows up to 2 simultaneous positions (one per direction). The ColorMETRO indicator is a trend-following colored bar indicator similar to Heiken Ashi but based on moving average crossover with color states. Signal is detected on completed bars only (bar[1] vs bar[2]) to avoid repaint. The EA checks for same-side positions before opening new trades, and closes opposite positions on signal reversal.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorMETRO custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. ColorMETRO is essentially a dual-moving-average crossover visualized as colored bars (typically 2 EMAs). The core logic can likely be replaced with equivalent EMA crossover calculations if the exact MA parameters are known. The duplex feature (allowing hedged positions) needs careful handling in Python backtest frameworks that may not natively support simultaneous long+short positions. Position sizing conditional logic (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be explicitly coded.
